news.title: All Quests for New Alcaz Prison Dungeon in WoW: Forever
news.description: Located in Dustwallow Marsh, Alcaz Prison is a new dungeon for players around level 50 in WoW: Forever. Here are all the dungeon quests you should pick up!
news.details:
Alcaz Prison
Alcaz Prison is on Alcaz Island, a lone island in the northeast part of Dustwallow Marsh. This dungeon is on the shorter side and will probably only take about 30 minutes.
The quests for Alcaz Prison are all pretty easy to get. You get three quests for each faction outside the dungeon, plus one in-dungeon secret quest. This secret quest offers a 25 gold reward and only appears when a boss is skipped. After pikcing up the quest, you can kill him for his quest objective.

news.title: Itemization of Crafted Tier Sets Revealed in WoW: Forever's First Raid Tier
news.description: The stats for the crafted versions of Tier Set gear from the first raid tier have been revealed in a hotfix to Forever!
news.details:
More Information:
Blizzard has confirmed with Wowhead that these items stats have been revealed intentionally and can be seen in game directly, as item obfuscation doesn't apply to items from vendors and recipes. They have also confirmed that the set bonuses are placeholder and will be updated in the future.
WoW: Forever's first raiding tier releases on December 9th with a global launch. While Blizzard has intentionally not revealed much about the bosses or the loot they drop, they have now revealed item stats for the crafted tier pieces. We know from a Crix interview that tier pieces will drop across all three raids, but what if you don't have a 40-man, or just get unlucky? Crafted Tier Set pieces could be the solution. These crafted pieces all have a unique quality, "Artisan's Tier (1)." This seems to indicate that you can craft exactly one piece of raid tier, which might give some…

news.title: Layer Swap and Other Targeted Layering Addons Will Be Disabled Soon in WoW: Forever
news.description: Targeted Layering Addons will no longer work in an upcoming hotfix for WoW: Forever, as various API calls that show a realm ID will be obfuscated soon.
news.details:
One popular addon on CurseForge right now is Layer Swap, an addon that helps facilitate layer hopping. Players use layer hopping for many reasons, but a main one is to find a new phase when the current one has competition. It can also help when some players are bugged on certain layers. With an addon like Layer Swap, players can see how many layers there could be, whether they've already been to a layer, and directly phase into the layer they want.
Image Credit: Layer Swap
An addon like Layer Swap does two things:
Facilitates invites to a new layer more easily by automating communication.
Allows the tracking and targeting of specific layers.
Blizzard has been communicating addon changes to authors through the WoWUIDev Discord since the Midnight expansion and with Forever now on the modern architetcture, they have started communicating updates there as well. With an announcement in the…

news.title: [UPDATED] All Skyborne Now Get Discount for Mounts Regardless of Reputation in WoW: Forever
news.description: All Skyborne now get a 10% discount on mounts in WoW: Forever, regardless of reputation.
news.details:
WoW: Forever Mount Guide
Article Update: Skyborne always gets a 10% discount now, regardless of reputation. The article has been updated.
With the release of WoW: Forever, players noticed that the Skyborne don't get a 10% discount with mount vendors. In yesterday's hotfixes, Blizzard mentioned this:
Blizzard
Fixed an issue preventing the Skyborne from being able to receive the Honored reputation 10% gold discount on their Apprentice and Journeyman Riding skills sold by Genn Fairweather on Zephras Isle.
While this seems to imply that Skyborne will now get the reputation discount for being Honored, the discount now seems to be active for all Skyborne. A character that is Friendly with the Windshapers still has the 10% discount for both the Rare and Epic mount skills. This likely means that it now gives a discount to all Skyborne, regardless of their faction reputation!

news.title: Unlock a Dungeon Shortcut in WoW: Forever with the Compound Key
news.description: Completing a quest in one of the new WoW: Forever dungeons will make future runs go a bit smoother: you'll gain a key to unlock doors leading to a final boss shortcut!
news.details:
One of the nine new dungeons in World of Warcraft Forever, Krol'dok Stronghold, has a quest within the dungeon where you’ll create a key that can be used to streamline future runs by unlocking various doors after acquiring it.
Krol'dok Stronghold Dungeon Guide
The quest, Krol'dok Moulding/Krol'dok Moulding, drops from an NPC in the dungeon named Tunk. When you kill him, you’ll receive the quest item, and you’ll need to bring it to Kreza Darkthorn in Rog’mar for Horde or Alphonse Dumas in Farholde Keep for Alliance (both in Riverglades). Before entering the dungeon and starting this quest, you can prepare 4x Thick Leather and 12x Iron Bar to complete the follow-up quest, Key Ingredients/Key Ingredients immediately and receive the Krol'dok Compound Key. Both quests award about 7,000 combined XP.

news.title: Every Quest for Level 30 to 40 Dungeons in WoW: Forever
news.description: Here are all the quests for the level 30 to 40 dungeons to help you level faster in WoW: Forever!
news.details:
Every Dungeon Quest Location
The level 30 to 40 dungeon bracket has one new WoW: Forever dungeon: The Drowned City. City of Dalaran is run by many players in their late 20s, but technically also falls in this bracket if you're looking for an easier run. These dungeons contain many new dungeon quests and bosses to explore. Be warned, Drowned City is a longer dungeon that will take at least an hour to complete on average, so make sure you have enough time to complete it.
